topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: When I first moved into the house, I noticed a slight discrepancy in the wall of what was to be my study—a subtle shift in the wallpaper that didn’t quite align with the rest. It was more of a whisper, a hint that something wasn’t as it seemed. One weekend, while rearranging the furniture, I decided to investigate. With a steady hand, I peeled back a corner of the paper. Behind it, a unmistakable outline of a door frame emerged. It was a hidden door, leading to a room I never knew existed. The discovery, rather than unsettling, felt like uncovering a piece of history, a private sanctuary waiting to be explored.
